The ocean at night is a place where the familiar weight of the world collapses, leaving behind only the crushing silence of the void. When the sun sets, the sky and the sea seem to merge into a single, endless expanse of darkness, but they are not truly one. The sky is black, a void that swallows the light, while the ocean is a surface that refuses to be submerged.
